question: Is operator-managed retention without a Gitcrawl deletion command acceptable for immutable snapshots containing private review text?
rationale: The patch intentionally retains private message content while removing raw metadata and source code, so code review alone cannot choose the permanent cleanup and retention boundary.

options.title: Approve documented operator retention
options.body: Accept the current design after exact-head proof and document concrete operator removal or expiry procedures for failed, superseded, and uncut bundles.

options.title: Require lifecycle controls first
options.body: Keep the PR open until the paired remote service exposes bounded deletion or garbage collection for immutable bundles.

options.title: Restrict private-repository rollout
options.body: Permit initial deployment only where retained review text is non-private until lifecycle controls are available.

recommendation.title: Approve documented operator retention
recommendation.body: Accept the current design after exact-head proof and document concrete operator removal or expiry procedures for failed, superseded, and uncut bundles.
